AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundr.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundr.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundr.

   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Food Nutrients.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Food Nutrients.

7. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only water vapour

8. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Removing all vegetation

9. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. joule (J)

10. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
